newsitem.title: USA: Adams March net asset value $23.80 shr.
newsitem.headline: Adams March net asset value $23.80 shr.

text.p: The Adams Express Company said Thursday its net asset value on March 31 was $23.80 per share - after a 1997 capital gain distribution of $0.09 per share - versus $22.15 a share one year ago.
The company also declared an interim dividend of $0.12 per share, payable June 1, to stockholders of record, May 19.

Adams said that it is regulated under Subchapter M of the Internal Revenue Code and distributes essentially all of its net investment income and capital gains in each calendar year. Because of that, the interim $0.12 dividend is included as part of a total distribution of $1.72 that has been paid or declared in the most recent twelve months.
